svg.aria-label: Sketch after a Brendan Smialowski/Pool/AFP via Getty Images photograph on ABC News: the rostrum of the United Nations General Assembly hall, seen from the floor. The background is the hall's dark green serpentine marble wall in large staggered rectangular slabs with pale veining. In the lower third stands the lectern: a light wood top with a thin metal rail on two posts across it, two slender microphone stalks rising from the surface and leaning toward each other, a small control box with three buttons at the right, and a tablet lying on the top. Below the wood top the rostrum's black marble front carries the United Nations emblem, a globe in azimuthal projection flanked by olive branches, cropped by the bottom edge of the frame. The speaker is not drawn.
